chapter: Own groups, bebop and Savoy sessions
title: Don Byas visits the London House

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah, I guess he went back to Dallas a few years after that, and that's I guess where he still is. Would you want to tell that story about Don Byas coming to visit you in the London House?
Yes, surely. This was just a few years ago. And he and Gene Ammons and Dexter Gordon, that is correct, they were having this battle of tenors and our boy, what's his name? Sponsored it.
No, the one that used to edit the Downbeat.

Dan Morganstern. And Don Byas called me and he was very sober. That afternoon he came over and talked We had a very nice conversation. The next day I went out to the recording session. And he was out there and that went down nice, you know, and the funny thing about Don, Don could speak that French very fluent, and--
He'd been over there for so many years.

Yeah, and Don could tell stories, jokes in French. Now whenever you can do that, you know it very good. Well anyway, that night after the session I couldn't stay until the session was over, because they were doing a double session and I had to go back to work. We were working at the London House.

With Jonah Jones, that's right, so I told Don I've got to leave. He said, 'Well Cozy, I'll come by after I finish the date.' I said okay. So he did, and he didn't have a collar and tie on, so they stopped him at the door. They said that you can't come in unless you have a tie. We've got a tie here for you if you want to put it on. Well he was half high and belligerent and said, Oh, I'm Don Byas, you know, well that Maitre d' didn't know anything about Don Byas, and didn't care, really. Don had been out of the country for 24 years, so this Maitre d' was young and so they exchanged words up there, so Jonah and I saw them up there and Jonah said to me, I wonder what's happening up there. I said I don't know, Don and them, you know, until the conversation got loud and then we knew. So after we finished the set, they sat down at the bar. They said we'll set you there at the bar where you can see Jonah and Cozy good, you know, and then there'll be off pretty soon and they will explain to you. So anyway, pardon me, when we finished, we took Don upstairs to the dressing room, our dressing room and explained to him, Well Don, in this place you just can't come in and sit down with other guests without a tie on. And he found that a little hard to understand but we managed to talk him into what was right.
